attchmntText: Akg Exim Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: AKG Exim Limited submitted a newspaper publication of its Unaudited Financial Results for the Second Quarter of Financial Year 2026-27 ended on 30th September, 2026. The company published advertisements in the Financial Express and Jansatta on Friday, November 13th, 2026. This filing complies with Regulation 47 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The details are also available on the company website at www.akg-global.com. The submission was made by Reeta, the Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, on November 14th, 2026.

attchmntText: Akg Exim Limited has informed the Exchange about Change in designation of Mr. Kalapi Vinit Nagada from Non-Executive Non-Independent Director to Whole Time Director Designated as Executive Director of the Company for the period of 5 Years.
voiceSummary: AKG Exim Limited announced the outcome of its Board Meeting held on November 13, 2026. The Board approved the change in designation of Mr. Kalapi Vinit Nagada from Non-Executive Non-Independent Director to Whole Time Director, designated as Executive Director. This appointment is for a term of five years, from November 13, 2026, to November 12, 2031. The appointment is subject to shareholder approval through postal ballot. Mr. Nagada has over 15 years of experience in the entertainment, digital media, content distribution, and real estate sectors. He is the Founder and Chief Executive Officer of Cinekorn Entertainment. The Board meeting commenced at 03:15 P.M. and concluded at 04:15 P.M. via Video Conferencing mode.

attchmntText: Akg Exim Limited has informed the Exchange about related Party Transactions
voiceSummary: AKG Exim Limited submitted a disclosure on Related Party Transactions for the half year ended September 30, 2026. This filing is pursuant to Regulation 23(9) of the Securities and Exchange Board of India Listing Regulations. The disclosure covers related party transactions on a consolidated basis in accordance with applicable accounting standards. The information is available on the company website at www.akg-global.com and the National Stock Exchange website at www.nseindia.com. The submission was made by Reeta, the Company Secretary and Compliance Officer. The date of the letter is November 13, 2026.

AKG Exim Limited filed its Integrated Financial Filing for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, with the National Stock Exchange of India Limited. The submission was made pursuant to SEBI Circular No. SEBI/HO/CFD/CFD-PoD-2/CIR/P/2024/185 dated December 31, 2024, and NSE Circular No. NSE/CML/2025/02 dated January 2, 2025. The filing was signed by Reeta, Company Secretary, on November 13, 2026.

attchmntText: Akg Exim Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: AKG Exim Limited held a Board Meeting on November 13, 2026. The Board approved the Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board approved an alteration to the Memorandum of Association to add a new object clause for producing and distributing audio-visual content, subject to shareholder approval. The Board approved the change in designation of Mr. Kalapi Vinit Nagada from Non-Executive Non-Independent Director to Whole Time Director, designated as Executive Director, for a term of five years from November 13, 2026, to November 12, 2031, subject to shareholder approval through postal ballot. The Board approved the Notice of Postal Ballot and appointed Mr. Ajay Kumar Prajapati as Scrutinizer for the remote e-voting process. Financial results are available on NSE and company websites.
